rdfs:label: owner
rdfs:comment: An agent (WebID) considered to have control, rights and responsibilities over a Solid storage; advertised by the server on the storage root or storage description resource.
notes: Solid storage-ownership predicate — declares the WebID(s) that own a storage (pod); the owner may be any agent, including an organisation. Per the Solid Protocol the server advertises it on the storage root / storage description. Distinct from `acl:owner` (a generic resource owner in the ACL vocabulary), `dcterms:rightsHolder` (broader copyright/IP ownership) and `urn:solid:creator` (who made it).

history.note: Scoped definition to storage ownership; range -> Agent; seeAlso Storage, protocol, acl:owner; notToBeConfusedWith ownerOf.
